control_A_leg_permutation.description: Per-triplet leg phases (phi_01, phi_12, phi_02) recomputed through the unchanged step_002->step_003 chain on every stored viable epoch; psi = phi_01 + phi_12 - phi_02 reconstructed after permuting one leg across triplets within each epoch ('xepoch': leg drawn from a different epoch). Destroys loop-level association while preserving every leg marginal, the estimator chain, and epoch weights.

control_B_nonfactorizable_screen.description: I(nu,t)=|E|^2 with E a complex Gaussian field whose conjugate spectrum concentrates on the measured J0437 arc curvatures (eta1=0.0072, eta2=0.0076 us/mHz^2, arclet |fD|max 6.50 mHz modelled as a Gaussian of sigma=3.25 mHz, arc thickness 0.0030 us) plus white noise matched to the observed flux statistics. Pushed through step_002/step_003 unchanged. Intensity cross-terms of a chi^2 field are non-factorizable by construction -- the standard-physics channel the factorizable step_008 suite cannot reach.

interpretation: If the permuted Rbar collapses well below the real value, the concentration is a loop-level association, not a leg-marginal artifact. If the realistic screen null's Rbar/mean is far below the observed psi=0.984 rad, Rbar=0.308 concentration, standard non-factorizable screen structure does not reproduce it.
